corrections.reason: The printed glyph is ኒ (3rd order) forming the standard Andemta demonstrative ከኒህ ('from these'), misread as ኔ due to ink spread at the foot.
The printed glyph at the end of the line is 1st-order ደ (እንደ ምን ነው = 'how is it?'), with no 5th-order loop.
The printed glyph is 6th-order ህ in ከዚህም ('and here'), misread as 1st-order ሀ.
Stage-1 OCR hallucinated Hebrew characters חי in place of the Ethiopic 3rd-order glyph ሒ in the canonical Ge'ez feminine imperative ተመልሒ ('be uprooted', Luke 17:6).
Both the image (showing the 2nd-order right-side stroke of ኡ) and canonical Ge'ez grammar (Luke 17:7, nominative subject 'his master' = እግዚኡ) confirm እግዚኡ rather than vocative እግዚኦ.
The printed Ge'ez word in Luke 17:8 is ዘእድራር ('that which I shall eat for supper', translated in L14 as የምበላውን), which Stage 1 misread as ዘአይፈር.
